Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production character cutout for an original cozy social simulation game called Whisperville.
Primary request: Create ONE original full-body character, Lin Duo, an outgoing young Chinese woman who owns the neighborhood coffee shop. She is about 28, with a rounded friendly face, warm almond eyes, a short fluffy chestnut bob with one loose curl, small freckles, and a bright conversational smile. She wears a cream rolled-sleeve shirt, a burnt terracotta apron with a small stitched leaf emblem, sage trousers and brown leather ankle shoes. One hand holds a white ceramic coffee cup with a little steam, the other rests on her hip. Include a cream dish towel tucked into the apron.
Style/medium: beautiful polished hand-painted 2D storybook game character art, gouache and colored pencil texture, refined warm dark-brown contours, softly shaded rounded volumes, tactile fabric, expressive face, sophisticated indie game illustration. Three-heads-tall stylized adult proportions, not a baby, not flat geometric vector art, not a 3D render, not pixel art.
Composition/framing: a SQUARE canvas. Exactly one standing character, entire hair and both shoes visible. Character upright centered, about 85% of canvas height with generous transparent space at the sides, head center at approximately (50%, 24%). Front three-quarter view, facing slightly toward viewer's right, no extreme perspective. Face large and readable. Full body occupies middle 60% of canvas width. Props stay near the torso. Isolated on truly transparent background. No scenery, no text, no labels, no frame, no circular backing, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no watermark.
Lighting/mood: warm gentle morning light from upper left, welcoming and full of personality.
Palette: warm cream, terracotta, sage green, chestnut. Preserve clean alpha edges suitable for placing over an illustrated map.
